args.description: crouches and presses the invisible opponent she is holding down to the floor with her free hand, then points a staff topped by a blue crystal star with ribbons down at it, then rises back into the ready stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame; nothing comes out of the floor or the weapon. The whole weapon stays inside the picture. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves her), always facing right, seen from the side; keep her look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what she holds: no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young woman with very long silver hair, a blue ribbon and violet eyes, a closed high-collared black and white top, a long black coat, loose black shorts reaching her knees over fully opaque black tights from waist to ankle, black boots, holding a staff topped by a blue crystal star with ribbons
args.initial_pose: holding an invisible opponent in front of her with both hands
